```{python}
#| label: tbl-too-many
#| tbl-cap: This should fail because two tables are displayed
from uv_python_runtime import display, Markdown

display(Markdown("""
| first | value |
| --- | ---: |
| a | 1 |

| second | value |
| --- | ---: |
| b | 2 |
"""))
```
